definitions.full: H4102. mahah [ מָהַהּ ] verb only Hithpalpel linger, tarry (compare Arabic slow walk, delay ( †am. )); — Hithpalpel Perfect 1singular הִתְמַהְמָ֑הְתִּי Psa 119:60 ; 3 plural הִתְמַהְמְהוּ Judg 19:8 ; 1 plural הִתְמַהְמָ֑הְנוּ Gen 43:10 ; Imperfect יִתְמַהְמַהּ Hab 2:3 ; ׳וַיִּתְמ Gen 19:16 ; Imperative masculine plural הִתְמַהְמְהוּ Isa 29:9 ; Infinitive לְהִתְמַחְמֵהַּ Exod 12:39 ; Participle מִתְמַהְמֵהַּ 2Sam 15:28 ; — linger, tarry, wait , of person, Gen 19:16 ; 43:10 (J), Exod 12:39 (E), Judg 3:26 ; 19:8 ; 2Sam 15:28 ; Isa 29:9 ; Psa 119:60 (with לֹא , opposed to חַ֫שְׁתִּי ); subject חָזוֺן vision Hab 2:3 מְהוּמָה see הום . מְהוּמָן see אמן . מְהֵיטַבְאֵל see יטב .
